text:
Your local voice assistant can read an entire answer without sending your words to a cloud service, and you can start listening to the first part while the rest of the response is still being generated on your own device.
Dr. Smith saved $12.50 on her 21st order, a discount of 12.5%. The package weighs 2.5kg. This is version v2.0, not a new language or a cloned voice. Clear speech matters more than impressive claims.
note: Loopback sockets allowed; resident model, sequential requests, one sample each
